name: Quartermaster

features.text: Configure category/item storage rules, priorities, presets and whole-furniture sections.
Sort inventory, containers, rooms, buildings and eligible floor items; shopping demands and Dibs lists.
Rooms integration and supply API used by Auto Clean.
physical shareable shopping papers and held-list HUD; paper supply inspections and ledger CDs.
PC Framework hosts Windows 93; Quartermaster registers the ledger reader and CD Writer app. Ledger freshness remains server-authoritative.
Carry grouping, progress, vehicle/trailer cargo and nested bags; optional Dangerous Load and extra carry allowance.
Sparse container/Whole/preset/room allocation profiles and percentage UI; bounded shadow accounting and reservation primitives. Enforcement and live role routing disabled.

Designated-room-only UI/server scopes with native building scope; retired native profiles stay dormant even through aliases. No-profile Shadow comparisons preserve ordinary native eligibility and capacity checks.

Paired development PC Framework 0.11.0-dev.1 owns the unified desktop and separate application/tool windows. Quartermaster supplies the shared digital/paper table, details and owner-bound writer results.

Portrait paper clipboard with a beveled spring clamp gripping the sheet, scroll-aligned ruling, separate selected-item details and resize grip with three-column ledger and page-turn controls. Server limits live computer statistics and automatic freshness to the exact recorded building; off-site/safehouse-wide CDs retain ordinary historical access. Supply Sheet creation requires a reusable vanilla clipboard and writing implement; one whole Notebook is consumed; no loose-page alternative.

Found Application CD runs SETUP.EXE via PC Framework CD program API 1. Server native-action completion installs per exact PC; guards digital reads/writes/automatic knowledge. Reusable disc, server prerequisite/time/loot settings; old ledger data preserved. CD loot targets commercial offices, office supply storage and computer stock; generic electronics/home desks/general cargo excluded. Completed setup releases its own drive binding; installed use does not require the Application CD nearby. Post-commit notification exceptions report installed/pending and retire the grant; installer prevents replay while its metadata hint is pending.

Default SortUpdatesLedger: server building search prefers an accessible completed paper ledger, native pickup, otherwise carried blank/partial paper; requires pen/pencil and writes confirmed touched storage once after the full successful Sort. Existing CD generations and unvisited inspection timestamps are preserved. No inventory mutation by bookkeeping. Initial ledger creation consumes one whole Notebook; subsequent writing reuses the ledger. Lost scan candidates fail closed; pickup returns to the original Sort source. Native cancellation clears local writing work and completion distinguishes movement from ledger outcomes. Native confirmation failures return their exact reason once and cannot close replacement work.
Physical Shopping paper controls restore across mode/settings changes with unique active-framework controller rows; fallback layout has a separate paper row and controller access.

Required B47ANCEDUI public Lua API 1 supplies shared controls, renderer, dialogs/tooltips, appearance editor and clipboard drawing; no embedded shared library. Application/server intent remains Quartermaster-owned.

Shared room/building Stock targets, paper/PC reports and PC-only low-stock alerts. Latest-per-area multi-CD/Base Ledger prefers connected loaded local-copy PCs and uses a completed carried CD for dated offline history. Requires paired PC Framework 0.11.0-dev.1 APIs and current permissions. MP testing candidate; no native/dedicated acceptance claim.

limits: Native SP/dedicated NOT TESTED for 0.24.0-dev.1; G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. Offline-CD and in-place CD rewrite are authorized for Workshop multiplayer test distribution; the verified 0.23.0-dev.1 upload remains historical evidence, not runtime acceptance. Requires Rooms, PC Framework 0.11.0-dev.1 and UI API 1; UI API 1 is Workshop item 3822582242; current offline pairing uses UI 0.3.0-dev.1. Base live inventory requires loaded powered authorized local-copy PCs; historical/partial stock cannot notify. Advisory allocation remains unenforced.

relations.text: Designated UUID geometry, metadata and independent action permissions; current storageScopes/roomDesignations contracts for advisory room profiles.
Required PC Framework 0.11.0-dev.1 development APIs: desktop/CD program 1 plus notification/connections 1; Quartermaster owns stock goals, ledger privacy and local-copy validation.
Client UI API 1 and scoped appearance; no gameplay dependency in provider.
